messages.subject: errors in part5 in GGIR 2.4.2
parts:
Hi, Vincent,

I would like to report an error found in part5

Error in `[<-.data.frame`(`*tmp*`, which(is.na(OF4) == TRUE), value = "") : 
  new columns would leave holes after existing columns
Calls: myshell ... g.shell.GGIR -> g.report.part5 -> [<- -> [<-.data.frame
Execution halted


When I check the R code of g.report.part5, I doubt this line might cause an error when there is no NA,

  OF4[which(is.na(OF4) == TRUE)] = ""

Thanks.
Best,
Wei

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] errors in part5 in GGIR 2.4.2
parts:
Thanks Wei,
This was fixed in the GGIR beta-version in August and will be part of the next CRAN release.
Best, Vincent
